written_by: Darby worker e4475a, 2026-10-04, before Gordon sees it
person_made_it: The full list of 57 dishes grouped by protein with search and filters, written like a board someone chalked by hand, not a database dump.
emcee_who_is_speaking: The same kitchen host, listing what is cooked, naming allergens only from the dish names and saying so.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Sunday afternoon, deciding next week; the search box is the first control.
did_the_click_pay_me: Yes: typing filters the 57 live and each row links back to the board to add it.
works_for_the_recipient: Fina can add or strike dishes in one list; eaters find pork-free or no-shellfish in one tap.
taught_me_something: Fifty-seven dishes with no macros is a menu, not a nutrition page; honesty about missing numbers beats invented ones.
told_me_the_truth: Macros are absent rather than invented; allergen marks say they come from the names.
weakest: No photos for 50 of the 57 dishes; the protein color block carries them until Fina sends plates.
